label: unexplained

reasons.text: Average order value rose because of a separate cluster of 140 orders between ₹38,010 and ₹44,930. The rest of the distribution is unchanged. Home decor festive lifts shift the whole range, not an isolated block.
9 card fingerprints and 3 devices account for 60% of the high-value cluster.
The site advertises DIWALI10, yet it appears in only 4% of spike orders, so the offer does not explain the volume.
97% new customers with near-zero social mentions: there is no visible demand source for an 8.2x spike.
2 posts say orders were never received.

evidence_requests: Invoices and courier AWBs for the 140 orders above ₹38,000
Proof of stock: purchase invoices for the high-value SKUs
Customer contact verification for orders paid by the 9 repeated cards
merchant_message: Large orders on a few cards with no shipping proof.
